events.title: Hernán Cortés lands on the Mexican coast
events.description: Cortés's expedition of about 500 men reached the Tabasco coast. Within two and a half years, with Indigenous allies, he overthrew the Aztec Empire and captured Tenochtitlan.
events.html: Cortés's expedition of about 500 men reached the Tabasco coast. Within two and a half years, with Indigenous allies, he overthrew the Aztec Empire and captured Tenochtitlan.

events.title: New College in Massachusetts is named after John Harvard
events.description: The college at Cambridge took the name of John Harvard, a young minister who left it his library and half his estate. Founded in 1636, Harvard is the oldest university in the United States.
events.html: The college at Cambridge took the name of John Harvard, a young minister who left it his library and half his estate. Founded in 1636, Harvard is the oldest university in the United States.

events.title: William Herschel discovers Uranus
events.description: From his garden in Bath, Herschel spotted an object he first took for a comet. It proved to be a new planet, the first discovered with a telescope, doubling the known size of the solar system.
events.html: From his garden in Bath, Herschel spotted an object he first took for a comet. It proved to be a new planet, the first discovered with a telescope, doubling the known size of the solar system.

events.title: Tsar Alexander II assassinated in St Petersburg
events.description: Members of the revolutionary group People's Will threw bombs at the Tsar's carriage. Alexander, who had freed the serfs, died within hours, and his son's reign brought harsh reaction.
events.html: Members of the revolutionary group People's Will threw bombs at the Tsar's carriage. Alexander, who had freed the serfs, died within hours, and his son's reign brought harsh reaction.

events.title: Winter War ends as the Moscow Peace Treaty takes effect
events.description: Finland ceded about a tenth of its territory, including Karelia, to the Soviet Union. Its stubborn defence had cost the Red Army heavily and preserved Finnish independence.

events.title: Gunman kills 16 children and their teacher at Dunblane
events.description: Thomas Hamilton opened fire in the gym of Dunblane Primary School in Scotland before killing himself. Public campaigning led to a near-total ban on private handgun ownership in Britain.
